issues.title: No 404 route in SPA router
issues.details: Unmatched routes fall through to homepage instead of showing a 404. This creates soft-404s that confuse Googlebot.
issues.fix: Add a catch-all route that renders a 404 page with proper status signal.

issues.title: Homepage has 2 H1 tags
issues.details: Multiple H1s dilute SEO signal. Use one H1, rest should be H2-H6.
issues.fix: Keep one H1, convert others to H2.

issues.title: 2 tool reviews under 150 words
issues.details: Short reviews may be flagged as thin content by Google.
issues.fix: Expand short reviews to 300+ words with specific details.

issues.title: No skip-to-content link in navigation
issues.details: Screen reader users need a skip link to bypass the nav.

issues.title: Missing E-E-A-T signal: Detailed review body
issues.details: 'reviewBody' not found in constants.ts. This data strengthens AI engine trust in your content.

issues.title: No Bing site validation file
issues.details: Bing Webmaster Tools requires a validation file for site ownership.
issues.fix: Add BingSiteAuth.xml from Bing Webmaster Tools.
